name: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
amount: Tuition plus living-cost contribution (Delft University Fund cites ~€60,000 total for non-EU students)
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET (submit with your MSc application)

eligibility.note: International students of any nationality; holders of a Dutch or TU Delft bachelor's degree are not eligible.

fields: Any TU Delft two-year MSc (engineering, science, design)
note: Results by end of March 2027. The scholarship form goes in together with the MSc application before 1 Dec; the regular MSc deadline (1 Apr) is too late for the scholarship.

name: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
amount: Varies by faculty: e.g. €25,900 (Law, 2026-27); some programmes equal to tuition fee (+€5,000 in Business). 2027-28 amount TBA
dlText: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET for most faculties (Social Sciences: 15 Feb 2027)
fields: Selected master's programmes across UvA faculties (law, business, economics, social sciences, humanities, psychology)
note: Each faculty runs its own AMS round and selects programmes; check your programme's scholarship page for the exact deadline and value.

nominationBody: University of Groningen admissions / faculty boards
name: Eric Bleumink Fellowship (EBF Talent Grant)
amount: Tuition, international travel, subsistence, books and health insurance
dlText: Complete your master's application by 1 Dec 2026 (time not stated; estimated from standing rules)

eligibility.note: Nationals of eligible least-developed countries (list in the official rules) with excellent records and no other means to fund the study.

fields: Any 1- or 2-year Groningen master's starting in September
note: You cannot apply directly: the admissions office and faculty boards nominate from complete master's applications; nominees hear before 1 Feb. Date estimated from the 2026 cycle rules.

name: Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship
amount: Tuition waiver + €20,150 (13 months) or €38,750 (25 months) living allowance, plus insurance and visa costs
dlText: 1 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET (master's application via Studielink by 10 Dec 2026)
fields: Selected master's programmes (law LLMs, financial economics, international business, learning & development)
note: 18 full scholarships per year; about 2% of applicants succeed. You must not have studied in a Dutch degree programme before.

name: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
amount: Full tuition fee (no living costs)
dlText: 1 Feb 2027 (time not stated); programme application by 15 Jan 2027
fields: Any Uppsala English-taught master's
note: Funded by the Swedish Council for Higher Education. The scholarship form opens 16 Jan 2027 only after you've applied to the programme by 15 Jan.

name: KTH Scholarship
amount: Tuition fee scholarship (check official page for 2027 cover)
dlText: 15 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
fields: KTH master's programmes (engineering, CS, architecture, sciences)
note: Results announced 1 Apr 2027. Only your first-priority KTH programme counts; documents for the programme application are due 1 Feb.

name: IPOET Scholarship
amount: 75% tuition fee waiver (renewable for year 2)
dlText: Mid-Jan 2027, aligned with the 15 Jan programme application deadline (time not stated)
fields: Chalmers master's programmes (engineering, CS, architecture)
note: Swedish-government-funded, administered by Chalmers. The 2027 window runs from late Nov 2026 to mid-Jan 2027.

name: Stockholm University Scholarship Scheme
amount: Full tuition fee (no living costs)
dlText: ~15 Jan 2027 programme application deadline (first round); scholarship date estimated from 2026 cycle
fields: English-taught 1- or 2-year master's programmes
note: Selection on study results and a motivation letter; results by end of April. The scholarship-specific deadline for 2027 was not confirmed—check the page.

name: DTU Tuition Fee Waiver for Non-EU/EEA MSc Students
amount: Full tuition fee waiver for the 2-year MSc (no living costs)
dlText: 15 Jan 2027 (MSc application deadline, time not stated); estimated from the standing schedule
tags: Separate waiver statement with MSc application
fields: DTU MSc programmes (engineering, CS, sciences)
note: Include a separate statement labelled as a tuition fee waiver application when you submit the MSc application, or you are not considered. Merit-based; results in April.

name: University of Copenhagen Danish Government Scholarship (Master's)
amount: Full or partial tuition fee waiver, in some cases plus a grant for basic living expenses
dlText: 15 Jan 2027 master's application deadline for non-EU applicants (time not stated); estimated from 2026 cycle
fields: Any KU master's programme (thresholds vary by faculty)
note: All admitted fee-paying applicants are considered automatically; decisions can come after you are charged the fee, which is then refunded.

name: Aarhus University Danish State Scholarship (Master's)
amount: Full tuition waiver; at some faculties (Arts, Aarhus BSS) also a monthly grant
dlText: Apply for the master's by 15 Jan 2027 (summer admission; time not stated)
fields: English-taught two-year master's programmes
note: Offers come with the admission letter. Natural and Technical Sciences give tuition waivers only; Arts and Aarhus BSS add a monthly living grant.

name: Tampere University Tuition Fee Scholarship (Master's)
amount: 50% of the €12,000/year tuition fee for the programme duration (rarely 100%)
dlText: 7 Jan 2027, 15:00 EET (application period 14 Dec 2026–7 Jan 2027; exact time not stated, 15:00 is the usual Studyinfo closing time)
fields: Tampere University English-taught master's programmes
note: Only a handful of scholarships are awarded across all programmes; accept your study place by 31 May 2027 to keep it. Results by 23 Mar 2027.

name: UNIL Master's Grant
amount: Monthly grant (below the ~CHF 2,000/month cost of living in Lausanne); check official page
dlText: 1 Nov 2026 (time not stated) – closed for 2027 entry

eligibility.note: Graduates of a foreign (non-Swiss) university with excellent academic results.

fields: Any UNIL master's programme
note: Ten excellence grants each year; online registration, one PDF and two referee emails to mastergrants@unil.ch by 1 November.

name: Geneva Graduate Institute Master's Financial Aid
amount: Full or partial scholarship or tuition reduction (scholarships up to CHF 20,000/year)
dlText: 14 Jan 2027 (time not stated); no aid in the March round
fields: International affairs, development, economics, law, political science, anthropology
note: Request aid in your master's application by the January deadline with a cover letter and proof of income; second-year renewal must be requested between April and May.

name: Émile Boutmy Scholarship (Master's)
amount: €18,500 tuition exemption per year for 2 years (€37,000)
dlText: 29 Nov 2026 (2nd committee; time not stated); 1st committee closed 18 Oct
fields: Sciences Po two-year master's (except journalism)
note: Tick the scholarship in the application's financial section and submit before the scholarship deadline, which is earlier than the programme deadline. One-year master's are not eligible.

name: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme
amount: Full course fees and a living stipend, plus leadership programme
dlText: Your course's Dec 2026 or Jan 2027 deadline (e.g. 6 Jan 2027, 12:00 UK time)

eligibility.note: Residents/nationals of eligible developing and emerging economies (list on Oxford's scholarship page); new full-time graduate students only.

fields: Selected one- and two-year master's (e.g. law, public policy, education, MBA/MFE)
note: Select the scheme in the graduate application and add the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann statement; applications held over to March are not considered. Decisions by end of May 2027.

name: Oxford-Pershing Square Graduate Scholarship
amount: Tuition, college fees and living expenses for both the master's year and the MBA year
dlText: 6 Jan 2027 for the 1+1 MBA (time per Oxford noon convention); master's by its own Dec/Jan deadline
fields: One-year Oxford master's followed by the MBA
note: You must be admitted to both the one-year master's and the MBA; upload the scholarship essay in the Funding section of the 1+1 MBA application.

name: Cambridge Trust Masters Studentship (International Fees)
amount: University tuition fee at the international rate (plus college fee for MASt)
dlText: Course funding deadline: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 depending on course (time not stated)
tags: Tick funding box in admissions application

eligibility.note: Applicants paying the international fee rate who do not already hold (or are about to receive) a master's or PhD.

fields: One-year postgraduate courses in any subject (not premium-rate courses)
note: No separate application: apply for admission by your course's funding deadline and indicate you want funding. Maintenance is not included.

name: UCL Global Master's Scholarship
amount: £15,000 for one year (split over two years for 2-year programmes)
dlText: Early May 2027, 17:00 BST (estimated from 2026 cycle: 7 May 2026)

eligibility.note: Overseas-fee-paying applicants from lower-income backgrounds, studying full-time in person.

fields: Any full-time UCL taught master's
note: Needs-based; you must have a complete master's application (with references) before applying. Distance-learning programmes are excluded.

name: Bicocca International Scholarship
amount: €10,000/year (gross) + tuition fee exemption, for 2 years
dlText: Be admitted and confirm enrolment by ~15 Mar 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle)

eligibility.note: Non-Italian citizens (dual Italian citizens eligible) with a foreign degree who do not currently live in Italy.

fields: English-taught master's programmes
note: Top-ranked admitted student(s) per English-taught programme are awarded automatically; renewal needs 40 then 60 ECTS.

name: UniTrento Scholarships for International Students (Master's)
amount: Tuition exemption + scholarship (2026 page: €7,200/year; €8,500 for women in STEM); check official call
dlText: ~4 Mar 2027, 12:00 CET admission call deadline (estimated from 2026 cycle; varies by programme)
fields: English-taught master's (CS, data science, engineering, economics, international studies…)
note: No separate scholarship application: top-ranked non-EU applicants in each programme's admission call get the award; renewable for year 2 with enough credits.

name: UGA IdEx Master Scholarships
amount: €9,000 for M1 year, €5,500 for M2 year (2026-27 call); tuition not covered
dlText: ~31 Jul 2027 overall window (estimated from 2026-27 call); programme deadlines often earlier

eligibility.note: International students applying to a UGA master's or engineering degree.

fields: UGA master's and engineering programmes
note: Paid in two halves (October and February). Each degree sets its own application calendar, so check your programme's dates.
